name: Philips Hue Smart Plug (EU)

radios.note: Bluetooth for direct app control; Zigbee (2.4 GHz) to the Hue Bridge. No Wi-Fi.

matter.note: No Matter certification found for the plug itself. Hue says products on a Hue Bridge work with Matter through the Bridge; Bluetooth-connected products can't use Matter.

apple_home.note: The German product page lists Apple Home among third-party systems; Hue's German guide links it from the Hue app with a Hue Bridge.

google_home.note: The German product page says voice control with Google Assistant needs a Hue Bridge.

alexa.note: The German product page says voice control with Alexa needs a Hue Bridge.

smartthings.note: The German product page lists Samsung SmartThings among third-party systems, and Hue's German Bridge guide lists SmartThings as a Bridge integration.

home_assistant.note: Official Hue integration controls devices connected to a Hue Bridge, locally.

hubRequired.note: Basic control works over Bluetooth from the Hue app; the Hue Bridge is needed for voice assistants, ecosystems and remote access.

localControl.note: Bluetooth control without a bridge or Wi-Fi; the Hue Bridge also offers a local API used by Home Assistant.

energyMonitoring.note: Hue's pages describe on/off switching only and list no metering, but none says explicitly that it is absent.

maxLoadWatts.note: Hue support gives 2300 W for mainland Europe; Great Britain and Ireland get 3250 W, a different model.

summary: With a Hue Bridge, the EU Philips Hue Smart Plug works with Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, SmartThings and Home Assistant. Without one, you're limited to Bluetooth on/off from the Hue app. The plug joins the Bridge over Zigbee, and the Bridge also exposes it to Matter platforms; the plug has no Wi-Fi and no Matter certification of its own. It's rated 2300 W for mainland Europe, and Hue lists no energy metering.
caveats: Voice assistants, ecosystems and remote access all need a Hue Bridge.
Bluetooth-only setups can't use Matter; the Bridge is what exposes the plug to Matter.
Rated 2300 W in mainland Europe; Great Britain and Ireland get a different model rated 3250 W.
Hue lists no energy metering, so don't count on power readings.
